name: Fujimaru Seijirou
source:
Favorite Food: Kyoto Style
The Strict Student Council President Who Hides the Part of Him That Lives in the Underworld

The student council president who thinks following the rules is the most important thing.
He was raised in a family that is involved in organized crime, so since he was young there are a lot of rumors going around about him and his family.
A loner type who thinks that he should be strict on himself and others, he has a lot of hidden fans however.
